summary: OpenAI announced an agreement to secure approximately 8 gigawatts-IT of AI computing capacity at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, in partnership with SB Energy, NVIDIA and the U.S. Department of Energy, with NVIDIA investing $1.5 billion in SB Energy and the site exclusively hosting NVIDIA compute infrastructure.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI is securing roughly 8 gigawatts-IT of data centre capacity, a large disclosed power commitment with a defined buildout schedule.
mechanisms.quote: OpenAI has entered into an agreement to secure approximately 8 gigawatts-IT at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, working with SB Energy, NVIDIA, and the U.S. Department of Energy.

mechanisms.reason: NVIDIA is committing a stated $1.5 billion investment plus credit support to fund the buildout of the initial capacity tranche.
mechanisms.quote: NVIDIA will invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy and will provide credit support for the land, power, and shell buildout associated with the initial 4.25 IT-GW.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI states it is contracting this capacity explicitly for projected frontier training needs.
mechanisms.quote: We are contracting for this capacity based on our projected long-term needs for frontier training and growing demand for our products.

mechanisms.reason: The capacity is also framed as meeting growing product demand, implying rising inference volume alongside training use.
mechanisms.quote: We expect to use this capacity to meet growing demand for advanced AI and maintain our lead as the frontier AI research laboratory in pursuit of our mission.

categories.reason: SB Energy builds, owns and operates the data centre and leases capacity to OpenAI as the customer, the defining structure of a neocloud hosting arrangement.
categories.quote: SB Energy will build, own, and operate the data center under a 20-year lease to OpenAI and deliver capacity over time. OpenAI will be the customer and will utilize capacity at the site

categories.reason: The site will exclusively deploy NVIDIA accelerators at multi-gigawatt scale, a direct demand signal for merchant AI silicon.
categories.quote: which will exclusively host NVIDIA AI compute infrastructure

notable_reason: An 8 GW-IT data centre commitment with a $1.5 billion NVIDIA investment in the infrastructure partner is a major, specific compute build-out disclosure.
